$comment: Written by hand from docs/evidence/adopt/adopt-proposal.json on 23 October 2026 because /bob adopt refuses a repo that already holds bob/ledger.json (R-bob-05). States and transitions: bob/schema.json. No state here comes from prose.

requirements.text: the BOB repo is BOB-governed: bob/brief.json exists, main unchanged until approved
requirements.check: Gate A refuses an unapproved write in a session on this repo

requirements.text: every BOB round ends with a report of at most three lines (stage, live, next step with its doer) before any detail
requirements.check: a round whose closing report breaks the shape is blocked at Stop with the shape named

requirements.text: each decision for Ash is asked once, as one popup, in the window that will run the answer, and the ask names that window
requirements.check: the next adoption costs Ash exactly two typed commands and no retry

requirements.text: a /bob command typed in a session where the plugin is not loaded is answered with the window to use
requirements.check: typing /bob status in a session on a non-BOB folder returns one line naming the workspace session

requirements.text: a session on a governed repo opens with the board visible: pane drawn, docs/status.html written and its path in the first message, before any question
requirements.check: the first assistant message of a session on ~/BOB or VGA names docs/status.html

requirements.text: /bob adopt accepts a repo that already holds bob/ledger.json, merging increments and never overwriting a record
requirements.check: adopt on this repo writes bob/brief.json and appends increments with every existing ledger record byte-identical

requirements.text: after /bob approve, the pane and the page show the approver and the time within the same turn
requirements.check: the page's APPROVAL field names the AP record

requirements.text: the design room's first run in Cowork is recorded with what Ash saw and disliked, as sources for the next increment
requirements.check: a sources/ file from that run exists

requirements.text: a person starts a project by saying the idea in plain words: Claude calls BOB's start_project tool and chooses the name; nobody types a command
requirements.check: live in a governed session: a project started from one sentence appears in bob-workspace.json and in the pane; the tool call and its result recorded

requirements.text: an approval is written only on a person's own input (a pane click or a typed command), never on a call Claude makes; the engine's person check refuses Claude's own call
requirements.check: live: Claude's own approve call is refused and the refusal text recorded; one click by Ash approves and the record is read back from bob/approvals.json

requirements.text: Gate B runs at every round end, including in a session where another plugin's Stop hook runs first
requirements.check: live with cc-plugin-sec-default installed: a round that writes a file and records no evidence is blocked, the block text recorded

requirements.text: the pane is a Project home: the current project, a Start a project button, and the other projects as buttons that make one current in one click
requirements.check: plugin test on terminal and desktop, then Ash's look: a click on another project makes it current; nothing typed

requirements.text: a round is approved or sent back with a note by pane buttons in a Waiting on you box, with requirement chips by state, Pause and See evidence
requirements.check: plugin test, then live: a click approval opens Gate A for that round; a send-back writes the note to the ledger and leaves the round unapproved

requirements.text: while a project is being designed, the pane shows the six design-with-bob stages with the current one marked, the brief so far, and review pages opened from buttons
requirements.check: plugin test: a synthetic project walked through two stages shows both marked done

requirements.text: no next action BOB shows asks a person to type a /bob command
requirements.check: a test over every next-action text the pane and the command replies produce: red on the 0.5.0 wording, green after

requirements.text: approving the next increment closes the active one when all its requirements are verified, so adding scope never costs two approvals
requirements.check: plugin test: approve INC-b with INC-a active and fully verified closes INC-a done and activates INC-b in one command; refused when INC-a has an unverified requirement

decisions.text: BOB's own build runs under BOB from 23 October 2026; every later change is an approved increment

assumptions.text: a Stop hook can read the closing report (U-02)
a user-level instruction line can answer a /bob command where the plugin is not loaded (U-01)

outputs.text: a three-line closing report every round
